item.description:
One setup for Claude and Codex.
- Settings → Setup shows instructions, skills, MCP servers, Claude app settings, defaults and ChatGPT Import in one place. - Review every change before applying. Backups, History and Undo are built in; files owned by an open app wait until it closes. - Share instructions and skills through links. Translate MCP servers between Claude and Codex, with an explicit choice when both sides differ. - Keep Claude chats, set autonomy, and clean up copied Import skills without rewriting their contents. - Edit your instructions, browse the gallery, or use the short writing wizard. Adopted rules are reviewed before saving. - New Claude windows start with your app settings and pins. - Use `openaccs setup` from the terminal and `openaccs vps user@host` to prepare a server. Each tool signs in there separately.
Installing this update does not apply the Setup plan. Open Settings → Setup to review it.

## Fixes
- **Pins are the same in every window.** The Claude app keeps a window's pins in its own browser storage and reads them only from there at launch. OpenAccs used to sync a card field the sidebar no longer reads. Now it writes the pinned chats where Claude reads them, while that window is closed. A pin or unpin wins in whichever window you made it. The first time, every chat pinned in any window stays pinned. - **Ultracode is the same in every window.** Claude keeps it per chat, apart from the effort, and OpenAccs now carries it over like the permission mode and the effort. - **A window that is open gets the changes when it restarts.** When you switch to it from OpenAccs and nothing is running there, OpenAccs restarts it. Otherwise its row shows what's waiting, with a Restart link.
## New
- **Settings and updates.** OpenAccs has a Settings window (More menu → Settings…) and updates itself: it checks once a day, and each update asks before it installs. This version is the first that updates itself; earlier versions need this one installed by hand.
## Install
Download `OpenAccs-0.3.3.zip` below, unzip it and move `OpenAccs.app` to Applications, replacing the old version. Requires macOS 26 or later. The app is signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple.
